### 2026-10-16 – Why is this 3D modeling too difficult. One svg was not coming into my required size I want in Fusion 360. So I moved to tinkercad. Its working as I made 1 out of 3 parts of my maze.

**2.58h**

Why is this 3D modeling too difficult. One svg was not coming into my required size I want in Fusion 360. So I moved to tinkercad. Its working as I made 1 out of 3 parts of my maze.

### 2026-10-16 – Finally I learned to model my project's part.

**1.9h**

Finally I learned to model my project's part.
1. Placing base and maze svg.
2. Making the parts to required sizes.
3. Grouping them together.
4. Downloading its stl file
5. Uploading the stl to the vendor I want to order from to get price quote, confirm size & print time.
6. Parts 1 out of 3 is done. 2 more to go.

### 2026-10-17 – What's happening with me?

**1h**

What's happening with me?
Initially decided to go with Fusion 360 but I was getting stuck with scaling.
So moved to make it on TinkerCAD & completed 1 out of 3 parts of the maze.
Then FAQ got updated & we are not allowed to use TinkerCAD.
Discarded that part got Gemini's help in figuring out Fusion's functions & did that part.
